definition.shared_affine_state: Xhat(z)=shell_midpoint+z*F(shell_midpoint) for rho,eta,p,a; alphahat(z)=1+z*k(shell_midpoint). Derived coefficients use these same functions.
definition.master_potential: W(t,z)=Vstatic(z)-35 tanh²(t)/4; temporal term retained exactly in true and hat, so errors cancel.

proof: At each complete cell, actual shell+z*F(outer) is valid by authenticated first-exit enclosure. Differentiate actual ODE through4 and the stated rational hat functions separately. Their interval difference, multiplied by ell^n*n!, encloses D_r^n(true-hat), uniformly including cell joins. Actual alpha uses its integrated negative k bound and alpha(0)=1. No derivative of point errors is taken.
